Given $△JKL$ shown above, which of the following diagrams represents the height corresponding to $\overset{―}{KL}?$
feedback.worked_solution:
The height (or altitude) corresponding to $\overset{―}{KL}$ is a line segment that 

- runs from the opposite vertex $J$ to the line $\overset{⟷}{KL},$ and

- is perpendicular to $\overset{⟷}{KL}.$

To draw the height, we proceed as follows:

- Extend the line segment $\overset{―}{KL}.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13945712/assets/8fa817d73f39106248403b6690757a701b2bdaf6e1b189a46572201d36f64554.png)

- Draw the perpendicular from $J$ to $\overset{⟷}{KL}.$
